subject: Grand Theft Auto VI
title: What time did GTA 6 unlock? Midnight ET Nov. 19, and it's out now
answer: Grand Theft Auto VI came out on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026, and is available now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. In the U.S. it unlocked nationwide at midnight Eastern, which was 11 p.m. Central, 10 p.m. Mountain and 9 p.m. Pacific on Wednesday, Nov. 18.
in_the_news: GTA 6 launched on Nov. 19, 2026, one of the biggest game releases ever, after years of delays.
body:
Rockstar's support page said the game would release at midnight local time on Nov. 19, 2026, in all regions. In the U.S., digital stores keyed the launch to Eastern time, so players in the West could start on the evening of Nov. 18. Where you could play first depended on your store's region (your PlayStation Network or Xbox account), not on the clock on your console.

Pre-loading opened on Nov. 10. PlayStation recommends at least 212 GB of free storage for the PS5 version, so if you are installing now, check your console's free space first.

The game is out only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version or date, following the pattern of GTA V, which reached PC well after its console debut.

faq.a: Yes. It launched on Nov. 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

faq.q: What time did GTA 6 unlock in the U.S.?
faq.a: At midnight Eastern on Nov. 19, which was 9 p.m. Pacific on Nov. 18.

faq.q: How big is the GTA 6 download?
faq.a: PlayStation recommends at least 212 GB of free storage on PS5.
No. Rockstar has not announced a PC version or date.
